outcome: Notice when your backups stop arriving.
setup: Configure the backup time, retention counts, catch-up interval and notification action in your home inputs. The Container setup uses /config/backups.
Review the rendered Home Assistant package and retention script; keep Home Assistant’s separate automatic backup schedule off and verify an archive is created.
Test the stale alert and plan a separate restore exercise. A successful file is not proof of recoverability.
